name: Notes
description: Markdown notes that are plain files in your synced folder.

actions.name: notes.list
actions.description: List notes, pinned first then recent first, and the folders. Optional filters: folder (and everything below it), tag, pinned. Pass since (a revision from an earlier call) to learn cheaply whether anything changed.

actions.name: notes.read
actions.description: Read a note: its text and an etag to pass back as base when writing.

actions.name: notes.write
actions.description: Replace a note's text (creating it and its folders if needed). Pass base (the etag you read) to refuse overwriting an edit made since.

actions.name: notes.create
actions.description: Create a note (kind note, the default) or an empty folder (kind folder) inside folder. The file name comes from the title and is made unique.

actions.name: notes.move
actions.description: Move or rename a note or folder. When a note's name changes, [[links]] to it in other notes are rewritten unless rewrite_links is false.

actions.name: notes.delete
actions.description: Delete notes or folders (with everything in them) from all devices.

actions.name: notes.search
actions.description: Full-text search with prefix matching. Words are ANDed; #tag words filter by tag.

actions.name: notes.tags
actions.description: Every tag with the number of notes that use it.

actions.name: notes.backlinks
actions.description: Notes that link to this note with [[wiki links]].

actions.name: notes.toggle_task
actions.description: Check or uncheck the task item on a line (0-based) of a note. Pass base to refuse a stale line number.

actions.name: notes.attach
actions.description: Store an image or file in the attachments folder next to a note; returns the Markdown to link it. Upload the file first (PUT /v1/blobs) and pass its blob hash (no size cap); small files may instead be passed inline as base64 data (up to 3 MiB).

blob.description: sha256: hash of an uploaded blob

data.description: base64, up to 3 MiB; use blob instead for anything bigger

actions.name: notes.pin
actions.description: Pin a note to the top of the list on this device.
